claims: As of mid-March 2026, Brent crude is trading around $100 per barrel.
As of mid-March 2026, WTI (West Texas Intermediate) is trading around $95-$96 per barrel.
Over 30 countries announced strategic reserve releases.
Brent Crude traded at ~$100.00 - $100.80 per barrel on March 12-13, 2026.
WTI Crude traded at ~$95.42 - $97.00 per barrel on March 12-13, 2026.
There are threats to the Strait of Hormuz.
There have been attacks on shipping in the Gulf.
Threats to the Strait of Hormuz and attacks on shipping in the Gulf have removed significant supply from the market.
The EIA projects prices could fall below $80 per barrel in the third quarter of 2026.
The EIA projects prices could average around $70 per barrel by the end of the year.
